title: Easy, High Protein Feta & Chicken Pasta Bake
description: A delicious, high protein, nutrient-dense pasta bake featuring feta, chicken, and cherry tomatoes that requires minimal effort.
steps: In a large baking dish, add the cherry tomatoes, feta block, chicken breasts, olive oil, salt, pepper, smoked paprika and garlic. Bake for 35 mins
Meanwhile, add the pasta to a saucepan of boiling water and simmer for 6-8 mins until tender. Drain.
Remove from oven, squeeze garlic from cloves and mix all ingredients together, shredding the chicken breast with a fork
Add the cooked pasta to the dish and thoroughly mix all ingredients together
Add basil leaves and Parmesan on top before baking for a further 5 mins.
notes:
The feta adds a luxurious sophistication.
